What the agent did: tohseno.com is now the home of Menlo, so this page is built for Menlo as it ships on 2026-10-14, not the earlier factory pages. The agent read the live site, its llms.txt and the repo README, and wrote one prompt carrying only those facts plus the site's own color tokens. A fresh Claude session with no other context got the prompt and wrote index.html once. It is published unedited (sha256 a7a9b4d29f2e008c6dac8cbbfebed4286f08307083ae268ee73fb4bc43d82352).

The page explains Menlo in the first screen with a four-stop diagram (your repo, the link, their Mac, their iPhone). It gives makers and people who were sent a link a door each. Its strongest section is the trust model: what a link tells you, what it does not, exact-version links and source reviews. Only real apps (Anky, Logos, Hello MENLO), real links and no invented numbers.

Checked in Chromium on the live URL: zero outside requests, no sideways scroll from 320 to 1440 px, all content readable with JavaScript off, light and dark themes, working copy buttons. Full page: https://omac049.github.io/poidh-proofs/proofs/1348/full-page.png
